d: Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.

Set along a two-kilometre stretch of private coastline, Madinat Jumeirah is a beachfront resort comprising four distinctive hotels. Each offers uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab, with experiences ranging from the contemporary elegance of Jumeirah Al Naseem to the majestic Arabesque charm of Jumeirah Al Qasr. Guests can also enjoy the serene waterfront setting of Jumeirah Mina Al Salam and the secluded Arabian houses of Jumeirah Dar Al Masyaf. Together, they form a one-of-a-kind destination rooted in Arabian luxury hospitality. The resort features over 20 curated restaurants and lounges, the traditional Souk Madinat Jumeirah, dedicated kids' clubs and some of the region’s most versatile event and conference spaces

d: Job Title: Human Resources Specialist (Governance & People Services)

Help people make a strong start at PureHealth and take their next career step within the Group. As a Specialist – Governance & People Services, you will be responsible for key HR operational processes across the full employee lifecycle.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4+ years’ experience in HR operations, people services or employee onboarding, with responsibility for coordinating onboarding across multiple teams.
Good knowledge of UAE Labor Law and regional best practices is mandatory
Proficiency in HR systems preferably Oracle Fusion with the ability to maintain trackers and prepare clear reports.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills, and preferable skills across the Microsoft suite of systems.

About PureHealth: PureHealth is the UAE’s largest integrated healthcare platform, committed to revolutionizing the nation’s healthcare ecosystem and advancing the future of health through innovation, technology, and world-class care delivery
r: Own the onboarding journey post offer acceptance through the first weeks in role. Set clear milestones, anticipate issues and coordinate with Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, IT, Facilities and hiring managers to get new joiners ready for day one.
Serve as the main point of contact for new joiners before they start and during onboarding. Provide clear instructions on documentation, first-day arrangements, and orientation.
Coordinate with relevant departments to confirm that employment documentation, system access, equipment, ID badges and workspaces are ready.
Lead, plan and facilitate corporate orientation sessions. Keep materials up to date.
Collect feedback from new joiners and managers. Use it to improve the process, resolve recurring delays, and make the experience more consistent.
Coordinate the visa process for new joiners in collaboration with the PRO team, ensuring all relevant documents are received and shared with the PRO team for visa processing.
Serve as the main point of contact for visa renewals
Own the medical insurance process including additions, edits, and deletions.
Support with year-end review of active policies ahead of renewal.
Own the offboarding journey from receipt of separation details through exit clearance and all offboarding formalities.
Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure all offboarding activities are completed.
Track employee exit feedback and share with relevant stakeholders.
Work with other functions such as Payroll, Total Rewards & Organizational Development team to ensure data accuracy in the HRMS data.
Update changes in the system in a timely manner and ensure documentation is stored on relevant employee files.
Assist in the development and implementation of P&O governance policies and procedures.
Check that required documentation and approvals are complete, record exceptions and escalate them to the appropriate owner.
Support HR policy and process updates by maintaining version control and communicating approved changes to the teams affected.
Respond to employee and manager queries within the role’s scope and coordinate with the relevant HR teams to resolve more complex cases.
x: At PureHealth, you’ll be part of a transformational journey to redefine healthcare through technology and human-centered innovation.
